title: SynthrAI in English: mass market or niche?
decision: Launch SynthrAI as a public paid product with a fully English site. How many users, and is it still a niche?

graham.reason: Real demand and growth is the core question

garyvee.reason: English-language attention, distribution with no audience

naval.reason: Leverage and what the founder owns

blakely.reason: Product from zero, will strangers repeat it

martell.reason: Solo founder, 10 hours, English support load

musk.reason: First-principles check on the real constraint

brief: Same product, now with a fully English site and a global audience. How many users, and is it still a niche?
assumptions: Market and cost numbers are assumed, not verified
English pool assumed 10 to 20 times larger than German, with more competition
